attempts.hypothesis: The fixed workload uses cumulative output, disabled detokenization, no parent request, and stream interval one. Cost should be mostly constant, with an additional finished-request cost and potentially a small token-count contribution.

pcvs.name: finished
pcvs.rationale: Captures completion-specific branches and finish-reason string conversion; the workload finishes every third request.

pcvs.name: new_token_count
pcvs.rationale: Captures any output construction cost that scales with the supplied token sequence.

attempts.hypothesis: The largest deviations are concentrated in the one-token and two-token inputs. Explicit indicators for these observed regimes, together with completion status and token count, should substantially reduce unexplained cost.

pcvs.name: finished
pcvs.rationale: Separates completion-specific work from ordinary output construction.

pcvs.name: new_token_count
pcvs.rationale: Retains token-size dependence and distinguishes the observed entry states.

pcvs.name: single_token_output
pcvs.rationale: Tests the unusually high cost observed for the single-token input, potentially associated with runtime initialization in this fixed workload.

pcvs.name: two_token_output
pcvs.rationale: Separates the second unusually expensive input from the relatively stable remaining calls.
